Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was driving through Pearland, Texas, heading toward a shopping center. I wanted to turn left into the parking lot
entrance, so I slowed down and waited for a gap in oncoming traffic.
Q: Were you already in the turn lane, or were you still in the through lane?
A: I was in the left turn lane. The light had turned yellow and I was waiting for the other side to clear.
Q: What happened next?
A: I started the turn when I thought it was clear. Then another vehicle came from the opposite direction and hit the
front passenger side of my car. I don't think it was going the speed limit, but I can't be certain of that.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only for a second. It was closer than I expected, and I had no time to react.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: My shoulder is really sore, mostly on the right side. It hurts when I lift my arm above my head, and I've been
wearing a sling for a few days.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider about the shoulder?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an
orthopedic doctor if it doesn't improve.
Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?
A: No, I was alone in the car.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly, since I need the car for work.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with the documentation we discussed.
A: Okay, thank you.
</page>
